lĭtūrārĭus , a, um, adj. litura,
I.of or for rubbing out.—Only as subst.: * lĭtū-rārii , ōrum, m. (sc. libri), books kept for the first rough drafts of writings, blotters (so called from the erasures made in them), Aus. praef. Idyll. 13.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
